direction: D1 The naming acceleration (pre-registered as 'the 2024 naming break'): content, composition, or tool?
outcome_primary: name_primary (NAME: coined lead before colon/spaced dash)

H1a.statement: Dated 2024 slope break in a segmented logit on U; holds in NA pool and non-LLM subset; sup-LR selects 2024/2025; placebo breaks 2020-22 null
H1a.verdict_note: not falsified (NA pool CI excludes 1 at paper and year level; no placebo as large); sup-LR selects 2023; on U the year-level CI includes 1; excluding 2026 the slope change is null; a dated 2024 break is not distinguishable from a convex trend or a 2023 break; Holm-adjusted year-level p 0.071

H1b.statement: Content's share of the 2023->2026 rise in [0.20, 0.50] for every name-masked representation; none >= 0.60
H1b.p_note: p tests the falsification boundary (share >= 0.60), not the prediction (share <= 0.50)
H1b.verdict_note: pre-registered spec with consistent (fold-ensemble) calibration: no masked share reaches 0.60 (not falsified), but the rolling shares exceed the predicted [0.20, 0.50] band, 0.60 lies inside every rolling CI, and intercept+slope recalibration puts R1/R5 rolling above 0.60; 'content is a minority' is not established

H1c.statement: Acceleration of content-unexplained drift: mean(u_2024-26) - mean(u_2019-23) > 0, ratio >= 1.5
H1c.telescoping_identity: diff = (obs_2026 - obs_2023 - sum cs_2024-26)/3 - (obs_2023 - obs_2018 - sum cs_2019-23)/5: an endpoint contrast; obs_2023 enters with weight -8/15

established_topics_only.note: u_y averaged over papers outside topic100 clusters whose share grew >= 3x vs the training window (exploratory split of the pre-registered new-topic placebo)

H1c.verdict_note: point estimate positive under every content specification; R1 two-stage year-level CI [0.03, 2.71] pp, raw p 0.022, Holm-adjusted p 0.067; year-label permutation p and the year-robust CIs of R3, the NA pool, the non-LLM subset, strict NAME and the excluding-2026 contrast do not exclude 0

H1d.statement: DFL reweighting of 2024-26 to 2023 composition (size x new keys x llm_topic) explains <= 30%
H1d.new_key_definition: share of declared keys not seen in y-2..y-1 (fixed lookback)

H1e.statement: Tool bounded: F=0 rise >= 85% of total; delta <= +5pp; max tool share at A_max < 0.25

tool.F_definition: F_d1 = f24_2 (>= 2 distinct RARE21 words in abstract) | f26 | title_typo
tool.A_note: A_max = 0.39 is the PLAN's held-out greedy abstract bound for 2026 (taken as given; not re-estimated in D1); sensitivity range 0.24-1.0; at A = 1 every paper is drafted and the F contrast cannot identify tau
tool.assumptions: linear delta*A model; nondifferential misclassification (F depends on NAME only through L); homogeneous NAME uplift tau in detected and undetected drafted papers; no spillover to undrafted papers; 2023 F share = pure false positives

H1e.verdict_note: criteria met for the pre-registered fingerprint after the misclassification correction; the bound is assumption-dependent (linear delta*A, nondifferential misclassification, homogeneous uplift, no spillover) and title-level markers give larger associations; positive control (D3) pending
H1e.positive_control_D3: PENDING: outputs/d3_register/ does not exist (D3 not yet run)

deviations_from_plan: Pilot ITS 1.28/yr was for colon (compound) titles; NAME estimated as pre-registered (all 4 definitions reported)
Added kink-only sup-LR scan as robustness next to the pre-specified level+slope scan (post hoc)
H1c paper bootstrap implemented as conditional (B=2000) and refit (B=300) versions; added year-label permutation and Welch tests
C grids for R2 (keywords) and R6/R6b (one-hot) widened after the first fit hit the lower grid edge
Cross-fitted intercept recalibration also applied in fixed (to 2023) and placebo (to 2020) windows
R2 treats each normalised keyword phrase as one token
R5 removes the 6 frozen move n-grams by token-subsequence match
DFL newcomer bin (.5,1) read as (.5,1]; keyless rows dropped
F for D1 = f24_2 | f26 | title_typo (the >=2 RARE21 variant per D3 note); A_max=0.39 taken from PLAN
R3 covers 2018-26 only (2019 rolling window trains on 2018)
Exploratory diagnostics added: R1u, R1n, R1@0.5, established-topics split of u, 3-year cumulative comparison
Extra script d1_summary.py for merging, Holm and figures
